resources.string: TrueVault can scan only files and folders you allow it to access. It cannot inspect private data inside other apps, encrypted chats, or your cloud accounts.
Pick a folder and TrueVault will compare what is in it against your vault, then show you every match before anything is removed.
This folder was larger than one scan can cover. Scan its subfolders separately to check the rest.
No copies of your secured files were found in the folder you allowed TrueVault to check.
You cancelled the removal, so that copy is still there.
This file is byte-for-byte the same as one already secured in your vault. Removing it leaves the vault copy untouched.
Same size and type as a secured file, but the contents were not fully compared.
You chose Secure Move for this file, but the original is still there — the removal was declined, or it did not go through.
A deleted file may still be recoverable from the system trash. TrueVault cannot see inside it.
This file lives on a cloud-backed provider, so copies may exist off this device. TrueVault cannot check those.
This location is not covered by anything you granted access to.
